title: Landmark map
blurb: A canvas draws a small page in grey and tints each landmark region with a colour for its role, labelled with the role and the name. Elements that look like landmarks and aren't get a dashed outline. A switch adds three faults, which are outlined in red.
question: Can a canvas show the landmark regions of the content it draws, with the roles a screen reader would announce, and point out what is wrong with them?
result: In Chromium 157 yes, from a rule table of 20 lines that gave the same roles and names as the browser's accessibility tree for all 32 elements of the drawn page, after two corrections that the comparison found. element.computedRole doesn't exist there, so the page can't ask the browser directly. A change to aria-label raises no paint event.
